title: Fortune 500 HQ Hunt (Part 1)
blurb: Twenty-five Fortune 500 companies, two and a half minutes, one blank map of the lower 48. A company appears and you click where it keeps its headquarters. Land in the same city or suburb for full credit, and the closer you land, the more points, up to 2,500. Part 1 of 20: all 500 companies on the 2026 Fortune 500, shuffled across the set.
